## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages use a conventional prefix (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `chore:` / `test:`)

- [ ] `go fmt ./...` is clean (CI has a gofmt gate)
- [ ] `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] `govulncheck ./...` is clean
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `FEATURES.md`) if behavior changed
- [ ] No credentials or secrets in code, tests, logs, or fixtures
